{"rules": ["Model consistently underestimates immediate post-spike volatility; true outcomes often reverse direction within 3-5 days of a forecast peak.", "When sentiment history shows isolated spikes (0.33) followed by silence, the model fails to capture the resulting mean-reversion or sharp drop.", "Forecasts exhibit strong upward drift bias relative to actual price action during high-volatility periods; apply negative correction factor when true outcome deviates >5% below forecast median.", "Model ignores short-term momentum reversal signals present in sentiment history; true outcomes frequently move opposite to the 30d trend direction within the first week.", "Apply aggressive downward adjustment if the last 3 days of history show a downtrend while sentiment remains neutral or slightly positive, as this often precedes a sharp correction not reflected in the forecast."]
